The comparison between the two webpages shows that the bad page has several issues:

*   The `<meta name="viewpo"` attribute should be spelled as `meta name="viewport"`.
*   The `<title>` tag has a typo: `tle` instead of `title`.

*   The `files/basic_webpage_README.txt` paragraph at the end of the page is also unnecessary.

The good webpage fixes all these issues.
